_about: What Clemency buys in the Holding, between runs. effect kinds: max_health (amount in health points), speed (amount in percent), jumps (amount added to the jumps a run starts with), dash (charges added), grapple, parry, recess, armory (the level the Carbine starts at). requires: an upgrade that must be owned first.

upgrades.name: Objection
upgrades.text: Right mouse: a quarter-second parry. Gold orbs that reach you inside it are turned back at whoever fired them.

upgrades.name: The Writ of Reach
upgrades.text: F: a grappling hook. Hold to be hauled to whatever it hits, and keep the speed when you let go.

upgrades.name: Spare Leap
upgrades.text: Start every run with a double jump.

upgrades.name: Standing Armory
upgrades.text: Start every run with a level 2 Carbine.

upgrades.name: Recess
upgrades.text: Once a run, a killing blow leaves you standing on a third of your health.
